name: root-crate-lib-split
body: The root crate's library target `src/lib.rs` (module FQN `rust.apg`) is organized as 7 sibling modules — `logging`, `frontends`, `warm`, `scan`, `pipeline`, `query`, and `install` — each in its own `src/<name>.rs` file beside `src/lib.rs`. The layout is flat: a nested crate root (e.g. `src/scan/mod.rs`) breaks the `include_str!("../opencode-suite/...")` paths that `src/lib.rs` uses relative to its own directory. The crate-root units `main`, `help_text`, `print_help`, `session_cmd`, `find_apg_root`, and `find_or_create_apg_root` live in the crate root.
